audit.root_cause: The env loads GEM/cochrane-simplification at revision 'refs/convert/parquet', and HF says that revision does not exist on the (public, ungated) dataset. The missing HF_TOKEN would not change that.
audit.evidence: OpenMed_CochranePLS.py:79 `load_dataset("GEM/cochrane-simplification", revision="refs/convert/parquet")`; load.log: `Revision 'refs/convert/parquet' doesn't exist for dataset 'GEM/cochrane-simplification' on the Hub.`
audit.irl_fix: Mirror the dataset as parquet under the author's own HF repo (or load from the default revision with datasets<4 / data_files) instead of relying on the auto-convert branch.
